name: shell_and_tube_steam_condenser
title: 1-2 shell-and-tube steam condenser (effectiveness-NTU)
summary: 1-2 shell-and-tube condenser of a steam power plant (30 000 water-cooled tubes, steam at 50 C) rated as a semi-isothermal exchanger with the effectiveness-NTU method: water temperature rise, Colburn-analogy water-side coefficient, overall coefficient and tube length.

verification.reference: Solution stored in the original EES file (CoolSolve misc/EES_ok.zip, EES_ok/exchangers3.EES, EES 9.920)
verification.notes: 24/35 variables within rtol=0.001 as printed by compare_solution.py; 11 differ, all traced to the EES 9.920 vs CoolProp liquid-water thermal conductivity at (1 bar, 28 C), 1.9 % (k_w, Pr, alpha_w up to 2.0 %; sizing A/L_tube 0.76 %, U 0.79 %). Energy-level results (T_w_ex, DELTAT_w, epsilon) within 0.1 %. No .initials needed (converges from defaults, 105 iterations).

related_external: CoolSolve examples/exchangers3.eescode (same model, kept in CoolSolve as a test case)
CoolSolve misc/EES_ok.zip: EES_ok/exchangers3.EES (original French EES file with stored solution)
